text: Alice is working on a program that has been initiated by a software company. There are multiple components to this program with complex interlinkages. Alice is working on preparing the PWBS (program work breakdown structure). Ana, a newly joined program coordinator, is assisting her in this program. She is confused and has little information about the program work breakdown structure. What can you tell her about the contents of the program work breakdown structure?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. It is a deliverable-oriented hierarchical decomposition that encompasses the total program scope.
B. It serves as the framework for developing the program master procurement document.
C. It includes program management artifacts such as plans, procedures, standards, processes.
D. It gives an overview of the program and shows how each component contributes to the program objectives.

text: Annie has been assigned as a program PMO for her organization. She is looking after the UC-Tech program which is an important program in her organization. While monitoring the UC-Tech program, she finds that the program team was confused about their roles and responsibilities. Which of the following documents should Annie check to review the whole program roles and responsibilities?

A program manager has been assigned a new program for developing a building infrastructure. This program includes multiple stakeholders with different expectations and views. Getting everyone's expectations understood and aligned is proving to be a challenge. What is the best way to move forward?
choices: A. Identify the stakeholders, determine who is positive and who is negative, and focus on engaging positive stakeholders.
B. Identify the stakeholders, determine who is positive and who is negative, and set up a hard strategy for the negative stakeholders.
C. Ask the sponsor for providing guidance on which stakeholders should be managed and can be ignored.
D. Identify the stakeholders, find their interest and impact, and determine the engagement strategy.

text: A program manager is performing the program cost estimating activity throughout the course of her program. Which of the following are considered the outputs of this activity?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

April, a program manager, is executing a program in a difficult environment where she is facing issues in interacting with stakeholders in the program. Which of the following activities can help her in interacting with stakeholders?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Utilize communications targeted to their needs, interests, requirements, expectations, and wants.
B. Grant access to all politically and legally sensitive information.
C. Assess the stakeholder's attitudes and interests toward the program and change readiness.
D. Include stakeholders in program activities.

text: Which of the following includes the activities that are necessary for the timely and appropriate generation, collection, distribution, storage, retrieval, and ultimate disposition of program information?
choices: B. Program schedule monitoring and controlling
C. Program quality assurance and control

text: Effective risk and issue management practices make sure that key risks and issues are escalated properly and resolved in a timely manner. The escalation processes typically operate at which of the following levels?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Outside the program, between the program management team, the program's steering committee, and other stakeholders
B. Within the program, between component teams, the program management team, and the program steering committee
C. Outside the program governance, between the program management team, the program's steering committee, and other stakeholders
D. Within the program governance, between component teams, the program management team, and the program steering committee

text: Which of the following statements are true about business value?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. It is the sum of all tangible and intangible elements of a business.
B. It is created through the effective and efficient management of ongoing well-established operations.
C. Brand recognition, public benefit, and trademarks are examples of tangible elements.
D. Monetary assets and market share are examples of intangible elements.

text: Katy is a member of the program steering committee. She realized that the resources in terms of both people and funding are major constraints. She also works for a pharmaceutical company, and all her work is heavily audited to ensure that her country's food and drug administration follows the best practices. She should consider legal and regulatory constraints while making selection decisions as the products must be submitted to the Food and Drug Administration for approval. Therefore, one of the key criterion that her committee uses is benefits to be realized and sustained by the products of the programs and projects. In which phase of the benefits management life cycle are program benefits qualified?

Honey, a program manager of an electronics company is responsible for a program to develop a high range of refrigerators. This range has a number of benefits and she wants to make sure that the target benefits are measurable. Honey has reached to the program delivery phase. One of the tasks of this phase is to:
choices: A. Formulate the program business case and program charter.
B. Produce the intended results of each program component in accordance with the program management plan.
C. Develop a program roadmap for achieving the expected outcomes.
D. Transit the program benefits to the sustaining organization.

text: Which of the following phases come under the program definition phase of the program life cycle?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

As a program manager, you have completed your cost estimation of the X-MAX program. Now, you are waiting for the approval of program cost estimation. Which of the following will drive the funding decision?
choices: A. Total cost of ownership costs relative to the expected benefit of the program
B. Program indirect cost to be realized
C. Program benefits to be realized
D. Program cost versus the benefits to be realized

text: As a program manager, you are in the program planning phase. As part of this phase, you need to create a plan to define how you'll transfer the benefits of the program to the operations of your organization. Which program management plan will you create?
When is the lessons learned database updated?
choices: A. At the program formulation sub-phase
B. At the program delivery phase
C. At the program definition phase
D. Throughout the program life cycle

text: Which of the following statements are true regarding the flow of information during the definition phase of a program?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Information related to progress, issues, risks, dependencies, outputs, and outcomes of component projects flows from the component project to the program and its other components.
B. Information related to the program's intended benefits, goals, and strategy flows from the program to its component projects.
C. Information related to project outputs and outcomes flows from the component project to the program to ensure that project benefits are fully realized and sustained.
D. Information related to strategies, objectives, needs, constraints, and timing of component projects flows back to the program.

text: Kim is a program manager of a large program and has a high profile in her organization. She finds that some of the stakeholders are negative regarding the program. She wants to work with these stakeholders to address their fears and concerns about the program. Which method will be most appropriate for this scenario?
What are the primary metrics for stakeholder engagement?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: B. Stakeholder frequency or rate of communication with the program team
D. Positive contributions to the realization of the program's objectives and benefits

text: All of the following are part of the program delivery management activity except for which one?

John has been assigned a new development program in his organization. During the program definition phase, he is required to give an overview of the program and show how each component contributes to the program objectives. Which of the following will help John in accomplishing the task?
When should a program manager perform the program quality control activity for monitoring specific components or program deliverables?
choices: A. At the end of the program phase
C. At the program delivery phase
D. At the program definition phase

text: According to the stakeholder map, which of the following are positions that categorize stakeholders based on their level of authority ("power") and their level of concern ("interest") regarding the outcomes of the program?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
Who among the following is responsible for making sure that any program within its area of authority defines its vision and goals for effectively supporting those of the organization?
Which benefits management plan should be developed before the program is closed?

Rose, a program manager, is managing an activity where she is ensuring that all the necessary resources are made available to the component managers enabling the delivery of benefits for the program. Which of the following appear as the outputs of this activity?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
Which of the following environmental analyses contains what-if analyses for describing how the program's objectives and intended benefits could be achieved in other ways?

John is recently appointed as a program manager in XYZ Inc. He has to manage an organization program. He started to review the program alignment with the organization strategy. Which of the following statements describes why organizations need to build a strategy?
choices: A. To define how organization's vision will be achieved
B. To determine the program's investment against the intended benefits
C. To show the dependencies between major milestones
D. To describe the success criteria that is maintained throughout the program

text: Stella is assuming a position in a company that has not had much experience with program management. She will be leading the program team and performing a business function for her program. The business case has already been made, and the program is scheduled to move into the program initiation phase. What is her most important skill as a program manager?
Who is an important part of the program governance structure and manages the relationship of the program with the overall governance framework?

A program manager is working on a complex program and facing an issue in engaging stakeholders. She wants to use a visual tool that makes her informed regarding decisions about how and when to engage stakeholders, taking into account their interest, influence, involvement, interdependencies and support levels. Which of the following will help in accomplishing it?

A program manager has been asked to create a quality management plan document for a program. Which of the following will she include in it?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

Kim is executing the activities of the benefits sustainment phase, and he is confused about the activities that he should verify. Which of the following activities should be verified by Kim?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. On-demand support for the product, service, capability, or results is provided.
B. Technical information concerning the product, service, capability, or improvement in response to frequent product support queries is updated.
C. A transition plan for facilitating the ongoing realization of benefits when turned over to the impacted operational areas is developed.
D. Operational, financial, and behavioral changes necessary for program recipients to continue monitoring performance must be planned.

text: Which of the following artifacts is created by a program manager that shows the program strategic alignment and sets up a timetable for the strategic benefits delivery?

The program integration management focuses on which of the following activities for identifying, defining, combining, unifying, and coordinating multiple components into the program?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
In an organization, program governance outlines the responsibility for which of the following?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: B. Planning for how the approach will pursue program and organizational goals
C. Authorizing the use of resources to support components and other program work
D. Setting and managing the regulatory and legal boundaries of their local and national sovereign governments

text: Program governance endorses programs reviews at key decision points in the program life cycle. These key decision points occur at the:
choices: A. Start of the program phases.
B. End of the program phases.
C. Middle of the program phases.
D. Start as well as the middle of the program phases.

text: Ana, a program manager, is establishing the business case and confirming for the program and then developing the detailed plan for the program. In which phase is the program manager working?
As a program manager, you have been asked to develop a response to a risk that has occurred, and the primary response for the risk proves to be inadequate. What type of plan is this?
An effective program sponsor should have which of the following attributes?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. Ability to provide training to ensure that standards and practices are well understood
D. Ability to work across different stakeholder groups to find mutually beneficial solutions

text: The make-or-buy decisions and program work breakdown structure charts techniques aid in which activity?

Stella has started managing a program. She is creating a document for ensuring that the program activities going to be performed must contribute to the program success. Which document is Stella creating?

As a program manager, Bella is analyzing the available information about organizational and business strategies, internal and external impacts, and program drivers for qualifying the benefits that program stakeholders expect to realize. In which phase is Bella working?

A program manager is establishing the benefits management plan for guiding the work through the remainder of the program and communicating program performance metrics to the key stakeholders. In which program benefits management phase is the program manager working?

You are performing a risk assessment of a program. After conducting interviews and meetings with the stakeholders, you have fixed a certain amount of risk that organizations and stakeholders are willing to accept. Which term is described in the given scenario?

Gisselle is a program manager of her organization. She is working on the program to develop medical imaging technology. During the program planning, she finds that there is some unavailability of resources within the program. To deal with this, Gisselle should work with the organization for developing which of the following documents to contract the necessary resources?
What are the primary purposes of the program definition phase?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. To progressively elaborate the goals and objectives to be addressed by the program
B. To initiate, plan, execute, transition, and close the individual components
C. To produce the intended results of each component in accordance with the program management plan
D. To define the expected program outcomes and benefits and seek approval for the program

text: As a program manager, how should you work with respect to the resource interdependencies and especially with the scarce resources?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. You should carefully control the schedule for scarce resources.
B. You should ensure that resources are not released for other programs even when they are not required for the current program.
C. You should make sure that the program resource management plan accounts for changes in use of interdependent or scarce program resources.
D. You should work to ensure that the interdependencies among different components of a program do not cause a delay in benefits delivery.

text: Kattie has been assigned a new development program for her organization. She has created the program charter document and started to get program authorization. If the program is not authorized, what action should be taken by Kattie?
choices: A. The program manager should do another trial for authorizing the program a few weeks later.
B. The program manager should record and capture the event in the lessons learned repository.
C. The program manager should do another trial to authorize the program after consulting the program governance board.

text: Gisselle is a program manager of her company. She is managing a T-MAX program, where she is required to integrate the back-office components of the company's system into a single system. The system includes information regarding sales, accounting, finance, personnel, program, and project management. She has reviewed the program business case and charter documents and uses the program management office's methodology both at the program and project levels. She has also performed a comprehensive analysis on how each stakeholder will be affected by the program's outcome. Till now she has identified 20 stakeholders and will add in her list as the program progresses. Apart from these activities, who will be the person responsible for providing resources on this program?

A program manager, Elle, is monitoring the performance of the product, providing on-demand support for the product, and planning for the operational, financial, and behavioral changes necessary for program recipients. In which program benefits management phase is Elle working?

A program manager needs to identify strategies and actions required for promoting the productive participation of stakeholders in decision making and execution. Which program artifact should the program manager refer?

A program manager needs to perform which of the following activities for verifying that a program component properly supports the outcomes of the program and aligns with the strategy and ongoing work of the organization before authorization?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: D. Create a plan to ensure the projects realize their intended benefits.

text: All of the following represent the responsibilities that a program manager has in an organization, except for which one?
choices: A. Managing interdependencies between components within the program
B. Ensuring that a program is selected, prioritized, and staffed according to the organization's plan and determining the optimal allocation and utilization of resources
C. Ensuring that the goals and objectives of the program remain aligned with the overall strategic objectives of the organization
D. Managing, monitoring, and tracking overall program benefits realization

text: Which of the following statements are true of enterprise environmental factors?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.
choices: A. These factors might affect the selection, design, funding, and management of a program.
B. These factors should be monitored to make sure the program stays aligned with the strategic objectives of the organization.
C. These factors refer to conditions that are not under the team's control and that influence constraints or direct the program.
D. These factors describe major program events for the purposes of planning and the development of more detailed schedules

text: Ana has been assigned as a program manager for executing a T-MAC program in her organization. The program infrastructure includes a risk manager who was appointed by the program steering committee. As per the stakeholder request, there occurs a major scope change in the program. When Ana started to apply a change management process for the request, the risk manager asked her to repeat the program risk management planning to accommodate this change. What will Ana do?
choices: A. She will tell the risk manager that risk management planning is executed once during the program definition phase, so there is no need to repeat it again.
B. She will repeat the program risk planning to accommodate the major change introduced to the program.
C. She will escalate the subject to the steering committee to get their feedback.
D. She will speak to the steering committee to let the risk manager concentrate on his job only.

text: Lisa is evaluating program quality against the program quality criteria and standards. Who is responsible for reviewing and approving the approach to quality management and the standards by which program quality will be measured?

Andy is a program manager of the X-TEL program. The program includes a number of key products and is responsible for delivering benefits. Currently, Andy is in the program definition phase. One purpose of this phase is to:
choices: A. Develop a program roadmap for achieving the expected outcomes.
B. Transit the program benefits to the sustaining organization.
C. Coordinate and manage the actual program's delivery.
D. Produce the intended results of each program component in accordance with the program management plan.

text: In which of the following cases is the program budget rebaselined?
choices: A. When a new program sponsor is assigned
B. When the changes are approved that have significant cost impacts
C. When the program is canceled

text: During which of the following phases is a program sponsor assigned by the sponsoring organization to oversee and govern the program?

As a project manager, you must be able to discern the difference between a project and an operation from the onset of a potential project. Projects have all the following characteristics except for which one?
choices: B. Creates a unique product, service, or result

text: A program manager, Emily, has approached to her program completion phase. She finds that some of the program budgets is left out and that was not assigned to any program activity, even after she considered the execution of all the closure activities. What should Emily do with this remaining budget?
choices: A. The unspent monies should be returned to the funding organization.
B. The unspent monies should be rewarded to the program team members for their excellent performance.
C. The unspent monies should be with the program manager.
D. The unspent monies should be utilized for any other program managed by the program manager.

text: Ryan is a program manager in an organization that uses virtual teams. Work is passed 24/7 from team members of one continent to those on another continent. Ryan has adopted the common 4,000-word vocabulary for use on all his projects; however, nine different languages are spoken by his team members. Which of the following will help Ryan to ensure that he does not make the same mistakes as he made in previous initiatives?

A program recovery specialist, Jack, has been hired and assigned for a program that is having major issues and is in the red zone. He did an initial assessment and finds out that neither the project level nor the program-level requirements have been fully completed. The requirements need to be finalized before the start of the program. Based on the complexity and magnitude of the program, he realized that a governance board for the program needs to be set up and the stage gate reviews must be done. Which of the following are activities that make up the benefits identification phase?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

B. Defining the objectives and critical success factors for the program
C. Establishing the benefits management plan for guiding the work through the remainder of the program

text: Richard, a program manager, is managing program activities such as program information archiving and transition, program risk transition, and program resource transition. In which program phase is Richard working?

Ana is a program manager of a multinational IT company. She is managing a curriculum for a training program. The program is dependent on different sectors within the company. Also, other projects and programs in the organization are linked to her training program at various levels. Since Ana realizes the importance of gate reviews and health checks, she needs to develop which of the following?

Stella is managing a program for the next-generation missile system of her country. The program governance board has approved the program management plan she has prepared. Now, she is initiating the various component projects of her program. In which phase is Stella working?

After you had been assigned to manage an important program in your organization, one stakeholder objected to initiate the program until the program feasibility study is developed. Which of the following is not considered a reason for the organization to have a feasibility study?

Which of the following will be the correct answer?
choices: A. Both Kate and Sam are describing it correctly.
B. Sam is describing it correctly.
C. Kate is describing it correctly.
D. Both Kate and Sam are describing it wrong.

text: April has been assigned as a program manager for a new program that involves manufacturing of discrete automation parts. To cover this risk, she purchases travel insurance for the equipment. According to the given scenario, the program manager has performed which program risk management activity?

A program manager, Rose, is in the program planning phase and is required to create the program information management plan. Which of the following elements will be included in the plan?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

Lisa has finished the execution of the program contract administration activity. What are the artifacts that are expected to be produced after this activity?Each correct answer represents a complete solution. Choose all that apply.

A project manager is running a project under a program, which is in progress as per the estimated timelines of the project. An additional change request has been received for the project which seems to be in line with the project objectives. This change request will cause a delay in the project delivery and will require additional funding from the company. Who is responsible to take a decision for this change?

text: All of the following are the outputs of the program quality management planning activity except for which one?

text: The program schedule management planning activities are normally documented under the program master schedule document. Which of the following doesn't describe this document?

C. Gives an overview of the program and shows how each component contributes to the program objectives
D. Identifies the agreed-upon sequence of component deliverables for facilitating effective planning of the individual component deliveries and of expected benefits

text: Who among the following is responsible for ensuring individual project management plans are aligned with the program's goals and intended benefits to support the achievement of the organization's strategic goals and objectives?

text: As a program manager, you are required to create a program master schedule planning document for defining the individual component schedules. Which of the following information will you include in it?

text: Who is responsible for analyzing available information about the organization's strategic goals and objectives, internal and external influences, program drivers, and the benefits that stakeholders expect the program to realize?

Bella is working as a program manager in XYZ Inc. One of her first task as the program manager was to prepare the business case and the benefits management plan. Now, she is measuring how each benefit is realized. In which phase of the benefits management life cycle is Bella working?

choices: A. Both Kate and Jenny are describing it correctly.

text: A program manager is communicating with her program team members through emails, small group conversations, and staff meetings. Which type of communication is she using?

Stella is meeting with her organization's program selection committee. She is selecting one of the two programs to undertake, as her organization has limited resources. choices: A. Developing meaningful metrics and KPIs
